test_title: PYST 12: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 02 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven boxes, M, N,O, P, Q, R and S, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept above S. Only one box is kept between R and S. Only three boxes are kept between R and Q. Q is kept at some place above S. N is kept immediately below Q. M is kept at one of the places above O. P is not kept immediately above or below R. Which box is kept at the lowermost position?
solution:
Boxes: M, N, O, P, Q, R, S (7 boxes)

Only 3 boxes above S

1 box between R and S

3 boxes between R and Q

Q above S

N immediately below Q

M above O

P not immediately above/below R

Top → Bottom arrangement using given conditions

Total positions = 7

3 boxes above S ⇒ S at position 4

1 box between R and S

⇒ R at position 2

3 boxes between R and Q

⇒ R(2) _ _ _ Q

⇒ Q at position 6

Q above S ✔

N immediately below Q

⇒ N at position 7

Remaining positions: 1, 3, 5

M above O

P not adjacent to R

Arrange ⇒ M(1), O(3), P(5)

**Final order (Top → Bottom):**

M

R

O

S

P

Q

N

**∴ Box at the lowest position = N.**

Hence the correct answer is **Option 1.**
